text: The historical patch makes default Thunderbird selection assertions read checked instead of the always-truthy value string. Its new generic smoke task advances through source options sequentially, checks pane/back-button visibility and returns, with an explicit Outlook/MAPI skip. These checks do not assert transferred mail/settings or successful behavior of every underlying importer. This study uses only Thunderbird/shared UI code and excludes SeaMonkey implementation/context. The historical path is absent at the fixed accepted revision; no current provider behavior or live test result is claimed.
title: The profile-import smoke task checks selection and pane navigation rather than migrated data
